analysis.conclusion: Correct for the observed failure. Crema registers a hosted singleton in afterRegistration, but hosted registration is not runtime reachability. At beforeCompilation analysis is sealed. AnalysisMetaAccess.optionalLookupJavaType -> AnalysisUniverse.optionalLookup consults existing type state without creating an AnalysisType. The baseline registerAsImmutable path creates a snapshot and otherwise tries to create the absent type after sealing.

isReachable is conservative and sufficient here. registerAsImmutable creates/registers a snapshot without marking it reachable or instantiating its type. Independent custom Feature forced the internal class reachable via registerAsUsed, explicitly verified isInstantiated=false after analysis, and the image built and executed successfully. No stronger isInstantiated guard is required by the observed invariants.

The upcall entry stub is registered as a root in beforeAnalysis by CEntryPointCallStubSupport.registerStubForMethod. The reachable branch retains both immutable registration and setUpcallStubPointer, so it does not introduce a missing method lookup or leave an actually reachable singleton pointer unset.

SubstrateOptions.isForeignAPIEnabled defaults to true except LLVM; ForeignFunctionsFeature uses that predicate. The patch follows runtime reachability instead of a separate option test. Runtime lookup/usage of the singleton by ForeignFunctionsRuntime makes its implementation reachable; existing initialization remains in that branch. Supplied ForeignTests passes validate enabled FFM compatibility, with fallback limitation below.

InterpreterForeignFunctionsSupportImpl already has DisallowLayered singleton traits. HostedImageLayerBuildingSupport rejects its registration in a layered image, before the changed beforeCompilation hook. This change neither adds nor claims layered Crema support.

Four-line gate addition invokes the existing HelloWorld compiler/build/run/output verifier with both explicit flags and includes proper experimental-option unlocking. Same generated source hash in supplied baseline/candidate caches confirms controlled source parity. Baseline fails on this exact singleton registration stack; candidate passes. The gate does not directly assert heap contents, exercise runtime-loaded code, or test FFM fallback, but is targeted to this build failure. Independent runtime loading probe adds useful runtime evidence. No unrelated production changes, blanket singleton inclusion, or new shared test features.

nonblocking_observations.detail: ForeignTests.TestFeature explicitly registers STRLEN and QSORT downcalls plus a direct upcall. Its two passing tests do not by themselves demonstrate the interpreter fallback getUpcallStubPointer branch. This is a coverage limit, not a detected product defect.

The new comment broadly equates unreachable with absent from HostedUniverse, whereas UniverseBuilder creates hosted types for all existing analysis types. The critical absent-type case is accurate and the implementation handles both absent and existing-unreachable types safely. This wording does not affect correctness.
